mapper.select: SELECT total_annual_leave FROM leave_balance WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND base_year = #{baseYear} FOR UPDATE

SELECT leave_request_id as leaveRequestId, approval_id as approvalId, employee_id as employeeId, start_date as startDate, end_date as endDate, leave_type as leaveType, leave_status as leaveStatus, used_days as usedDays, reason as reason, reject_reason as rejectReason FROM leave_request WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY start_date DESC, leave_request_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT leave_request_id as leaveRequestId, approval_id as approvalId, employee_id as employeeId, start_date as startDate, end_date as endDate, leave_type as leaveType, leave_status as leaveStatus, used_days as usedDays, reason as reason, reject_reason as rejectReason FROM leave_request WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND start_date <= #{endDate} AND end_date >= #{startDate} ORDER BY start_date ASC, leave_request_id ASC

SELECT lr.leave_request_id as leaveRequestId, lr.approval_id as approvalId, lr.employee_id as employeeId, lr.start_date as startDate, lr.end_date as endDate, lr.leave_type as leaveType, lr.leave_status as leaveStatus, lr.used_days as usedDays, lr.reason as reason, lr.reject_reason as rejectReason, e.employee_name as employeeName FROM leave_request lr JOIN employee_hr_info h ON h.employee_id = lr.employee_id JOIN employee e ON e.employee_id = lr.employee_id WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM employee_hr_info target_h WHERE target_h.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND target_h.org_id = h.org_id ) AND lr.start_date <= #{endDate} AND lr.end_date >= #{startDate} ORDER BY lr.start_date ASC, e.employee_name ASC, lr.leave_request_id ASC

SELECT leave_request_id as leaveRequestId, approval_id as approvalId, employee_id as employeeId, start_date as startDate, end_date as endDate, leave_type as leaveType, leave_status as leaveStatus, used_days as usedDays, reason as reason, reject_reason as rejectReason FROM leave_request WHERE leave_request_id = #{leaveRequestId}
SELECT leave_type FROM leave_request WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND leave_status = 'APPROVED' AND #{date} BETWEEN start_date AND end_date LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN leave_status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 END) as pendingCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN leave_status = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 END) as approvedCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN leave_status = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 END) as rejectedCount FROM leave_request WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO leave_balance ( employee_id, base_year, total_annual_leave, used_annual_leave ) SELECT employee_id, #{baseYear}, 15.0, 0.0 FROM employee WHERE employ_state = 'WORK'
